articles.headline: USMNT's Folarin Balogun gets red card vs. Bosnia-Herzegovina
articles.description: Folarin Balogun's star-turn at this World Cup went sideways early in the second half on Wednesday night, as the American forward was sent off against Bosnia-Herzegovina.

articles.headline: World Cup live updates: Balogun sent off as 10-man U.S. lead Bosnia-Herzegovina
articles.description: The United States kicks off its 2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage as take on Bosnia-Herzegovina in the round of 32.

articles.headline: USMNT fans in Washington, D.C., erupt after Balogun's opener
articles.description: USMNT fans in Washington, D.C., erupt after Balogun's opener

articles.headline: Veteran Belgium rally to beat Senegal and show aging squad isn't finished
articles.description: Belgium showed incredible character in rallying from down 2-0 to defeat Senegal in extra time. Was their comeback a sign of things to come, or one last flourish from a golden generation of players?

articles.headline: Belgium advance through controversial penalty
articles.description: Belgium win 3-2 over Senegal and advance to the Round of 16 following a Youri Tielemans penalty in extra time.

articles.headline: Switzerland's Embolo praises Algeria's coach before World Cup clash
articles.description: Switzerland's Breel Embolo praised Algeria coach Vladimir Petkovic for transforming the Swiss national team during his seven-year tenure, a day before the two sides meet in the World Cup round of 32 on Thursday.
